turns.text: hey, how's it going?
how's it going with you? mine has been a slow one.
not much, you?
same here really, a lazy one. any plans for later?
morning! coffee yet?
two coffees in already, i did not sleep great so it is needed.
what did you get up to this weekend?
not a lot. cleaned the kitchen, watched a film, needed the weekend rest.
how's the weather over there?
how's the weather here? raining again, i got soaked without an umbrella.
any plans for the weekend?
no plans set yet. maybe my sister, if she is free this weekend.
how was your day?
long day but fine. busy morning, quiet afternoon, cannot complain.
did you eat yet?
yeah, i ate about an hour ago. still full, honestly.
what are you up to?
just watching TV and folding washing. not up to much, very exciting.
how's work going?
how's work? same as always, busy but nothing dramatic, counting down.
you good?
yeah i am good. a bit tired, but who is not these days?
how was your weekend?
good weekend actually. market on saturday, nothing at all on sunday.
what have you been watching lately?
i have been watching that cooking show everyone talks about, three in.
did you do anything fun?
nothing fun really, just food shopping. a long call with my mom though.
how's the family?
family all good, my brother got a job and will not stop.
you seem cheerful today
do i seem cheerful? must be the sun, first dry day all week.
what's new with you?
not much new. same job, same apartment. i did start growing tomatoes though.
how's your week been?
up and down week. monday was a nightmare, better since.
fancy a chat?
sure, i have got time for a chat. nothing good on TV anyway.
how have you been?
not bad, bit run off my feet but getting there. you keeping well?
how's it going?
how's it going? alright, cannot complain. just making dinner here.
just got home myself. what are you making?
just making a stir fry, i always end up with too many noodles.
same here. i always cook for about six people by accident.
me too, always cooking for six. leftovers for days then.
what did you think of the game last night?
bummed. the game was ours, two up with ten minutes left.
smart. i sat through all of it and regretted every second.
smart. i am skipping the highlights, not wasting a second on it.
did you have a good weekend?
yeah, a good weekend. we tried that new cafe on the main street.
oh what's it like? i keep walking past it.
i like it, a bit pricey but the coffee is good.
you look tired
that obvious? i look tired, the baby was up at four again.
oh no. mine used to do that. it does end, i promise.
i am holding you to that promise. coffee is my best friend now.
any plans tonight?
no plans really, just a bath and an early night tonight.
that sounds perfect actually. i might steal that idea.
go for it, i stole the idea from someone else anyway.
how's the new place?
how's the new place? loving it, boxes everywhere but the kitchen is handled.
haha fair. how long till you're properly unpacked?
knowing me, six months till i am unpacked. one box is still sealed.
what have you been up to?
not up to much, work and TV. i started a jigsaw on sunday.
how big?
it is big, a thousand pieces. i have done only the river.
lovely day out, isn't it?
really lovely, i have had the windows open all morning.
i went for a walk at lunch and nearly got a sunburn. in october, can you believe it.
i know, but a walk in october like that is a gift.
how's your mom doing?
how's your mom? mine is much better, back to her old self.
haha that's good to hear. give her my best.
will do, and she sends her best. she asked if you eat properly.
did you watch that thing everyone was on about?
i tried to watch it. gave it twenty minutes and turned it off.
me too! everyone keeps saying it gets good after episode four.
if it is not good in twenty minutes, life is too short.
how was your vacation?
your vacation was brilliant. did nothing but sit by the pool and read.
that sounds like heaven. got any photos?
i will show you the photos tomorrow, one cat adopted us.
what are you doing this weekend?
not sure yet. the weekend looks decent so maybe a walk somewhere.
nice. we're thinking of the beach if the rain holds off.
do it, the beach might be the last warm one before winter.
morning! how are you today?
good morning. i slept properly for once and feel like a new person.
hey, long time no speak!
i know, it has been a long time. how have you been?
not bad. busy with work but good busy. what about you?
same here, busy with work. we should catch up properly soon.
what are you having for lunch?
probably just a sandwich for lunch. i keep saying i will meal prep.
me neither. i bought a nice flask for soup and used it twice.
that flask deserves better than twice, you should use it more.
did you sleep okay?
not really, i did not sleep well. the neighbor dog barked all night.
oh no. is it the one that does it every full moon?
that is the one. i am thinking of leaving a note about it.
how's the diet going?
do not ask, i had fries for breakfast. the diet is going badly.
breakfast fries are a strong choice honestly.
fries for breakfast is fine, the diet starts monday as usual.
what's the plan for tonight?
no plan really, leftovers and a bit of TV tonight.
same. i might ring my nan, she's been asking about me.
that is nice, give your nan a ring, she will love it.
you free this weekend?
i think so, i am free. why, what is happening this weekend?
was thinking of a bbq if the weather holds.
count me in for the bbq. i will bring the sausages.
how's the garden coming along?
slow going in the garden. the slugs are winning at the moment.
welcome to gardening. beer traps, that's my only advice.
do the beer traps actually work, or is that a myth?
mostly it just gets you drunk slugs, but yes, it works.
good, the slugs are winning so i will try anything now.
did you hear about the road construction on the main street?
yeah, the road construction started monday. the bus now takes about ten years.
i know, my commute's gone up by twenty minutes.
your commute is twenty minutes longer, it better be fast broadband.
what have you been reading?
i have been reading a crime book set in a small village.
haha sounds right up my alley. is it good?
it is good, a real page turner, i stayed up till one.
how was the dentist?
all clear at the dentist. no fillings, just a lecture about flossing.
that's a win in my book.
a win, i walked out feeling like i got away with something.
you seen the forecast?
rain all week, apparently. the forecast is typical for october.
i saw that. i was going to wash the car as well.
do not bother, the rain will wash the car for free.
how's the new job?
loving the new job. friendly team and i am learning loads.
that's great. better commute too, right?
so much better. i can walk the commute in twenty minutes now.
morning, you up?
barely up. the alarm went off twenty minutes ago and i've been staring at the ceiling since.
coffee or tea today?
coffee, definitely. tea doesn't touch the sides on a monday.
i slept terribly last night
oh no. what kept you up? i was awake half the night myself, the wind was howling.
what time did you finally get to bed?
way too late for bed. got sucked into a documentary and lost track of the clock.
how was the drive in?
slow drive. a crash on the highway, it took nearly twice as long.
you take the train today?
yeah, the train was rammed. i stood the whole way squashed against the doors.
traffic bad?
not too bad actually. i left early and missed the worst of it for once.
did you get any sleep at all?
a bit of sleep. the neighbors were up late so it took ages to drop off.
still tired?
still tired, always. i need a really early night instead of another five hours.
what's for dinner?
no idea for dinner. might just do eggs on toast, can't be bothered cooking.
did you cook or order in?
ordered in. i meant to cook and then the sofa won.
have you eaten?
not eaten yet. i'll make something in a bit, just having a coffee first.
how's the washing going?
endless washing. machine has been on twice and the pile has not gone down at all.
did you do the dishes?
yes, the dishes are finally done. the sink had been building up all week.
you get the shopping done?
yeah, the shopping's done. quick trip, but i forgot the milk so i'll be back tomorrow.
did the parcel turn up?
your parcel turned up, left with the neighbor again. i'll grab it from them later.
trash day today?
it is trash day and i completely forgot. heard the truck and ran out in my socks.
how's the apartment looking?
apartment's a state, honestly. i keep meaning to tidy and then find something else to do.
did you vacuum in the end?
i did vacuum, in the end. took ten minutes after i'd put it off for a week.
how are the plants doing?
mixed bag on the plants. tomatoes thriving, herbs dead. i have a very specific skill set.
anything growing on the balcony?
one tomato plant still growing on the balcony. i talk to it a bit, honestly.
how's the garden?
overgrown garden. i keep saying i will deal with it on the weekend and then do not.
did you water everything?
yep, all done this morning. it's been so dry everything needs it twice a day.
how's the dog?
demanding dog as ever. he has worked out that staring at me gets him a walk.
how's the cat?
asleep on my keyboard, which is where the cat lives now apparently.
did you walk the dog yet?
walked the dog twice. he's got more energy than i do and it isn't close.
you get out for a walk today?
yeah, a walk round the park at lunch. it cleared my head a bit.
did you make it to the gym?
no, never made the gym. packed the bag and everything, then sat down and never got up.
how was the run?
brutal run. went too fast at the start and regretted it about a mile in.
weather holding up?
sounds like the weather is gray and drizzly, the kind of day you just stay in.
is it cold out?
freezing, properly cold. heating's been on since six and i'm still in a sweater.
what's it like out there?
sunny but windy. lovely if you're out of the wind, horrible if you're not.
did you hear the storm last night?
i heard the storm. something was banging outside and i never worked out what it was.
how's your evening going?
your evening sounds quiet. TV on, phone in hand, nothing much happening. it's nice actually.
what are you watching?
i'm watching some old quiz show. not even paying attention, it's just on in the background.
you still up?
still up, yeah. should have gone to bed an hour ago. i do this every night.
big plans tonight?
no big plans tonight. bath, book, bed. i've been looking forward to it all day.
how's the new book?
really good new book, nearly finished. i keep staying up late for one more chapter.
you read much these days?
i don't read as much as i'd like. by the time i sit down i just fall asleep.
did you speak to your mom?
yeah, i spoke to my mom. long chat, mostly her telling me to eat more vegetables.
how's your dad doing?
your dad is doing well, out in the garden every day.
did your sister call?
my sister called, yeah. she wanted to know if we're still on for sunday.
any word from your brother?
one word from my brother, a photo of his new kitchen. that's about all i get.
how are the kids?
loud kids. one has learned to whistle and will not stop, it has been a long day.
how's the little one?
into everything now, the little one. turned my back a second and she had emptied a drawer.
did you get everything done?
most of it done. there's always one thing left over that i'll do tomorrow.
busy day?
a busy one. back to back until four, then it went dead quiet, almost worse.
how did the meeting go?
fine meeting. could have been an email, honestly, but at least it is done.
work alright?
work is alright, same as ever. nothing on fire, nothing exciting. i'll take it.
did you finish that thing you were working on?
that thing is finally finished. took way longer than it should have, but it's off my plate.
you got the afternoon off?
off this afternoon? i wish. no such luck, i am stuck here till five like everyone else.
you on lunch?
just sat down to lunch. got a sandwich and twenty minutes of peace and quiet.
long day?
a long one. i've been running about since eight and i'm only just sitting down.
how's the new place coming along?
getting there, the new place. i finally put up a shelf, only took me three weekends.
did the move go alright?
fine move. smoother than expected, only broke one glass, which is a record.
how's the neighbor situation?
your neighbor situation is fine mostly. upstairs plays music late sometimes, nothing drastic.
did the landlord sort that out?
your landlord took care of it, surprisingly fast. someone came by tuesday and fixed it in ten minutes.
you get the car fixed?
the car's not fixed yet. it's booked in for friday so i'm on the bus till then.
did you get your hair cut?
got the hair cut, finally. been putting it off for weeks and it took half an hour.
how was the dentist?
all clear at the dentist. she gave me the usual lecture about flossing and i nodded along.
did you go to the doctor in the end?
i went to the doctor. nothing serious, just a cold. he said rest and fluids.
feeling better today?
feeling a bit better, thanks. it's easing off, i can breathe through my nose again.
you alright?
alright, yeah, just tired. nothing a quiet night won't sort out.
you seem quiet today
quiet because i'm beat. didn't sleep well and i've been dragging myself round all day.
how are you holding up?
holding up alright. busy week but i'm getting through it, looking forward to the weekend.
you had a good weekend?
really good. saw some friends, ate too much, did nothing on sunday. the perfect mix.
what did you get up to on saturday?
on saturday i went to the market in the morning, then spent the afternoon doing absolutely nothing.
did you go out last night?
no, stayed in. i've been out too much lately and my wallet needed a break.
you doing anything nice this weekend?
nothing nice planned this weekend. hoping to get out for a walk if the weather holds.
any plans for the week?
no plans for the week. quiet one, which suits me after the last few.
what are you up to later?
later? nothing much. might pop to the shop and then just chill at home.
you free later?
i should be free later. give me a shout when you're done and we'll sort something.
you about this evening?
yeah, i'll be about this evening. come round if you fancy it, i've got nothing on.
fancy grabbing a coffee sometime?
i do fancy a coffee. i'm free most mornings this week, just say when.
how's the coffee at the new place?
really good coffee there. i have been going every morning, it has become a bit of a habit.
did you get the coffee machine working?
working now, after a fight. i had put the wrong beans in the coffee machine and it clogged up.
how's the TV treating you?
TV is the same trash as always. i keep watching things i don't even like.
did you finish that series?
finished the series last night. ending was a let down but i'd come this far.
what time are you finishing today?
finishing at five today, hopefully, if nothing blows up. i've got a quiet evening planned.
you working from home today?
working from home today, yeah. best part is no commute, worst part is the fridge right there.
how's it going?
going alright, just got in from work. feet up for five minutes.
long day?
a long one. you look up and it's dark before you know it.
i hate those, mine was the same.
same here, at least it's over now. food and an early night fixes it.
you up for a walk later?
maybe a walk later, it depends on the weather holding off.
it's meant to be dry after four.
dry after four works for me. text me when you're heading out.
did you get the shopping?
got the shopping eventually, yeah. the line was massive though.
tell me about it, i went at five and gave up.
you gave up at five? i stuck it out and it took forty minutes.
how was your weekend?
your weekend sounds like it was a good one, nice and quiet.
quiet is underrated.
quiet is underrated, honestly. i barely left the apartment all weekend. how about you?
you watching the game?
yeah, the game is on now. i've got one eye on it.
who's playing?
the usual lot playing. it's not going well, i might turn it off.
what are you having for dinner?
pasta for dinner again, i think. no imagination at this hour.
you have pasta every night.
pasta every night, i know. it's quick and i'm lazy, that's the whole reason.
how's the new job going?
going well, the new job, still learning everything though.
that's normal for the first month.
first month nerves, i keep telling myself. everyone says it gets easier.
did you sleep ok?
didn't sleep great. kept waking up every hour or so.
same, the heating was too high.
same here, heating was too high. i turned mine off and froze instead.
you been out today?
been out today, just to the shop and back.
exciting.
exciting stuff, i know. my life is a thrill a minute.
how's your mom?
my mom's alright, thanks for asking. she keeps busy.
is she still doing her walks?
still doing the walks, every morning without fail. rain or shine, good for her.
what time do you finish?
i finish at five, hopefully. could be later if it's busy.
fancy a pint after?
a pint after work sounds good. see you at the usual place.
did you get the apartment tidy?
your apartment is mostly tidy. the bedroom's still a mess though.
that's the one room nobody sees.
exactly, that's my excuse and i'm sticking to it.
you get any reading done?
got a bit of reading done, on the train.
what are you reading?
reading some thriller. it's not great but it passes the time.
how's the weather looking for tomorrow?
looks like rain tomorrow, by the look of the weather.
of course it is.
of course it is, typical for a saturday. i'll believe it when i see it.
did you hear back about the thing?
no word on the thing yet. it's driving me crazy.
give it a couple of days.
a couple of days is what everyone says. i'm just impatient, waiting is the worst.
you still doing your runs?
still doing the runs, every other morning without fail.
that's more than me.
more than you, maybe. it's the only time i get to myself, so i make the effort.
how's the puppy settling in?
settling in slowly, the puppy. he cried all night.
oh no.
yeah, neither of us slept. i'm told it gets easier.
did you manage to get out?
didn't get out, no. got roped into helping my brother move.
oh no, how was that?
heavy. my back's had it. glad it's done though.
what's the plan for tonight?
no plan for tonight really. might watch a film.
anything good?
nothing good, probably. but it beats scrolling on my phone.
you ok? you seem off.
i'm ok, just tired. it's been a long few days.
you sure?
yeah, i'm sure. long week, that's all it is.
i'm shattered today
shattered here too today. i've been up since five and it's only just catching up.
you awake?
awake, sort of. i've been lying here listening to the rain for twenty minutes.
did the alarm go off?
yeah, the alarm went off and i hit snooze about four times. classic me.
what woke you up?
the garbage truck woke me. they come at six thirty now and it's brutal.
i had a trash night
a trash night, oh no. what happened? mine was fine, just far too short.
you make coffee yet?
just made the coffee. the first cup is the only one that really counts.
how many coffees have you had?
three coffees so far. i should switch to water before my hands start shaking.
tea or coffee this morning?
tea, actually. i've been sleeping badly and coffee makes it worse.
you sleep alright?
didn't sleep alright, in and out. the cat decided three in the morning was playtime.
what time did you get up?
six thirty, which is far too early a time for a saturday.
did you get back to sleep?
got back to sleep eventually. took about an hour of staring at the ceiling.
you up late again?
up late again, yeah. fell into a youtube hole and lost two hours. no regrets.
i've been up since six
up since six, you poor thing. i don't know how you do it.
how's the commute?
fine commute today. got a seat and read the whole way, which never happens.
did the bus show up?
showed up twenty minutes late, the bus. i was starting to think i had imagined the timetable.
you walking in?
walking in, yeah. it's only twenty minutes and the weather's decent.
was the train busy?
packed train. i had someone's backpack in my back the whole journey.
you drive or get the train?
train. parking in town is a nightmare and i'm not paying for it.
traffic on the way home?
awful traffic home. took me an hour to do a fifteen minute trip.
you home yet?
home just now, walked in. shoes off, kettle on, that's the routine.
how's the washing machine?
noisy washing machine. it has been banging away for an hour and i am ignoring it.
i finally finished the washing
finished the washing at last, good feeling. mine's been sat in the basket for three days.
did you sort the laundry?
didn't sort the laundry fully. i separated the colors and then forgot to put it on.
you ironed that shirt?
didn't iron the shirt. hung it up wet and hoped for the best. it's fine.
how's the cleaning going?
slow cleaning day. i did the bathroom and then sat down and lost the plot.
did you clean the kitchen?
cleaned the kitchen, yes. it took longer than i'd admit, mostly the stovetop.
did you take the bins out?
took the bins out, yes, and the recycling. i'm basically a model citizen today.
you change the sheets?
changed the sheets, yeah, finally. nothing beats fresh bedding, honestly.
did you vacuum?
no vacuum yet. the carpet's seen better days but i'll get to it.
i'm having an early night
an early night sounds smart, i might do the same tonight.
what's cooking?
nothing cooking yet. i'm still deciding between something real and a bowl of cereal.
you making dinner?
making dinner, yeah, a curry. everything's chopped, just waiting on the rice.
how did the curry turn out?
good curry. went a bit heavy on the chili but i like it.
did you burn it?
didn't burn it, but it was close. i wandered off and forgot about it for ten minutes.
what are you having?
having leftovers again. i made too much on sunday and i'm still working through it.
i forgot my lunch
forgot your lunch, nightmare. there's a decent sandwich place round the corner if you need it.
did you eat properly?
define properly. i had toast at eleven and called it lunch.
you tried that new recipe?
tried the new recipe, yeah, the pasta bake. it was alright but i'd use less cheese.
how's the plant?
thriving on the windowsill. the other plant has given up entirely.
did you water them?
i did water them, and i repotted the big one. it needed it, roots everywhere.
anything flowering yet?
nothing flowering yet. the roses are done, but the herbs have gone crazy.
how's the tomato plant?
your tomato plant is still going. got three off it this week, a good haul.
did you mow the lawn?
haven't mowed the lawn, it's been too wet. it's starting to look like a field out there.
how's the garden looking?
scruffy garden but alive. i keep meaning to tidy the borders.
you been to the shop?
been to the shop, yeah. just bread, milk, and a chocolate bar i hadn't planned on.
was it busy?
busy, packed. i lined up for ages and the self checkout kept shouting at me.
did you get everything?
got most things, not everything. forgot the eggs, so breakfast's going to be interesting tomorrow.
how much did that cost?
don't ask about the cost. went in for three things and came out forty bucks lighter.
you use the self checkout?
tried the self checkout and it judged me. went to a real person in the end.
did the delivery come?
showed up, the delivery, but they left it on the porch and it is raining, so we will see.
you sign for it?
didn't sign for it, no. they just left it, didn't even knock, which is typical.
how are the neighbors?
the new neighbors seem nice. they said hello and everything.
is the music still going?
stopped around eleven, so no complaints about the music.
did you say something to them?
didn't say anything, no, i bottled it. i'll mention it if it happens again.
you hear that noise?
i heard the noise, yeah. it's been going all evening, i think it's next door's washing machine.
how's the apartment?
your apartment is cold. the heating's on and it's still not warming up properly.
is the boiler working?
it works eventually. takes about an hour to get going, the boiler is ancient.
did you fix the tap?
fixed the tap, yes. one washer and twenty minutes of swearing and it's handled.
you put that shelf up?
still in the box, the shelf. i keep looking at the drill and walking away.
how's the lightbulb situation?
better lightbulb situation. i finally changed the one in the hall, only took a month.
did you find your keys?
found the keys, they were in the door. the whole time. i'm losing it.
my phone's about to die
my phone's always on ten percent too. it's a lifestyle at this point.
i'm soaked
soaked here too. i got caught in it, no coat and everything.
what's on tonight?
nothing on tonight. i might have an early night and actually sleep for once.
you staying in?
staying in, yeah. i've been out every night this week and i'm done.
what time are you off to bed?
bed soon, hopefully. i keep saying that and then finding something else to do.
you tired?
tired, exhausted. i've been yawning since three in the afternoon.
how are you feeling?
feeling alright. bit run down but nothing a quiet weekend won't fix.
you take anything for it?
i take the usual. a cup of tea and a sit down, that's my medicine.
feeling any better?
feeling a little better. the headache's gone, so the main thing is settled.
how's the week treating you?
long week. counting down to friday already and it is only tuesday.
you got much on today?
not much on today. a couple of things but nothing major, mostly just plodding through.
how did the morning go?
good morning until i spilled coffee on my shirt. wore it anyway.
you get everything you needed?
got everything i needed, more or less. the list's done and that's what matters.
did you manage a break?
barely. ate a sandwich at my desk, which isn't a break, i know.
you got time for a chat?
got time for a chat, always. i'm just pottering about, nothing that can't wait.
how's your evening?
your evening sounds quiet, just how i like it. cup of tea and some trash on TV.
what are you up to this evening?
this evening, not much. might do a bit of tidying and then call it a night.
you doing anything later?
nothing planned for later. i will see how the evening goes and probably just relax.
you fancy a coffee tomorrow?
a coffee tomorrow, yeah, go on. there's a place near work that does a decent one.
what time suits you?
any time after ten. i'm not a morning person and i've stopped pretending.
how's the new mug?
ridiculous new mug. it is the size of my head and i love it.
you still drinking that herbal stuff?
still drinking the herbal stuff, yeah. it's not the same but my sleep's been better for it.
did you sleep through?
sleep through at last, yes. eight hours straight, i feel like a new person.
you get any rest?
got some rest. better than yesterday, so i'll take the win.
how's the back?
stiff back still. i slept on it funny and now i am paying for it.
did you stretch?
did stretch, a bit. the physio exercises are boring but they do help.
you been for your walk?
been for the walk, yeah, before breakfast. the park was empty, it was lovely.
how far did you go?
not far, just round the block a couple of times. twenty minutes, that's all i've got.
you get out at all?
got out only to the bin. it's been one of those days where the sofa wins.
i can't believe how cold it's got
how cold it's got is crazy. it was warm last week and now it's freezing.
did it rain on you?
of course it did. the rain got me without a coat, soaked in two minutes.
is it meant to clear up?
meant to clear by the afternoon, supposedly. i will take the umbrella just in case.
you put the heating on?
put the heating on, yeah, i caved. it was either that or wear gloves indoors.
how's your mom?
my mom's fine, she's been round for tea. brought cake, so no complaints.
you call your dad?
called my dad, yeah, quick one. he mostly wanted to talk about the football.
did you hear from your sister?
heard from my sister, she texted. she's coming up next month, which will be nice.
how's your friend doing?
my friend is on the mend. back at work part time and in good spirits.
you see anyone today?
didn't see anyone today, just the postman. it's been a quiet one.
what did you get up to?
what did i get up to? honestly nothing. cleaned, ate, watched some TV.
you up to much?
